svg.title: Foreword — about Divisha
svg.text: study artificial intelligence and machine learning in Bengaluru. Most of what I
make sits where engineering meets mathematics: small models, signal
processing, data pipelines, and the systems that hold them together.
I care about how things work down to the part people usually skip, whether that is
an OS scheduler, a parallel loop or a spiking neuron. Then I try to build something
that solves a problem a real person has.
Systems engineering, parallel computing and software are where I spend
my time. AI and ML are what I am still learning to do well.
